origin.description: Turns named values into id = json ; lines.

arguments.name: .types
arguments.text: TRUE adds a JavaScript type after the name.

origin.details: Each value is toJSON plus a space and a semicolon. A second variable is separated by a blank line. A newline inside a value is indented by the width of the name plus three spaces.
origin.example: asJSVars(a = 1:2, b = "x"), then a typed integer and matrix, then qualifier "var". The three results are separated by ---.
